lastCompletedStory.title: Stop cam init from writing the unread permission_mode key

openQuestions: src/config/permission-mode.ts (readPermissionMode) remains a genuinely dead module (no caller anywhere reads it, confirmed by grep before this story) and was deliberately left untouched per this story's notes, which flagged it as scoped to a separate US-002. A follow-up story should delete src/config/permission-mode.ts (and DEFAULT_PERMISSION_MODE) outright unless a future spawn path is wired to actually read it.
nextStoryContext: US-001 (CAM-458) removed cam init's dead permission_mode config-write step entirely: both runInitLinear and the interactive writeConfigOutcome/CheckDef('config') path, plus the now-dead defaultConfigPath/configPath/homedir/join plumbing in src/commands/init.ts, the index.ts init --help Behaviour line advertising the write, and the stale doc comment in src/config/toml.ts. mergeIntoConfig itself stays in src/config/toml.ts (still test-covered by test/toml.test.ts, unrelated to this story). test/init.test.ts now asserts init leaves the CAM_CONFIG_PATH target absent (real tmpdir fs check) instead of asserting on permission_mode content. Gotcha for any future negative-grep oracle: the oracle matches the literal token anywhere including your own explanatory comments -- see the new patterns.md bullet.
